none: PAS FindID 972268: Roman Coin: Irregular Nummus of the house of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. A splendidly irregular nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Fallen Horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust diademed right, large eye and strong outline; a square with a star of eight points - or a schematic thunderbolt shield blazon on a square shield or standard - on the cheek. A superseded legend below all this, perhaps [--]NVS[--].…
